refresh_cadence: daily, a capped sample (at most 150 new replays per format per run, one request a second)
records_captured: Rated Showdown ladder battles of each registered regulation (Bo1 and Bo3), one row per side: the six at team preview, the Pokémon that entered the battle, the leads, Mega Evolutions and the result (docs/upgrade-plan-2027q2.md, S3; laundry list #27)

fields.name: format_id
fields.description: The ladder format, the regulation registry's munchstats_format plus "bo3" for the Bo3 ladder

fields.name: regulation_code
fields.description: The registry's regulation_code for that format

fields.name: uploaded_at_utc
fields.description: When the replay was uploaded, ISO-8601 UTC (always inside the regulation's window)

fields.name: rating
fields.description: The battle's ladder rating as the search lists it; empty when it lists none (a Bo3 set's first game)

fields.name: turns
fields.description: The last turn the log reached

fields.name: result
fields.description: win, loss or tie, for this side

fields.name: team_size
fields.description: How many Pokémon each side brings (the log's teamsize, 4 in VGC)

fields.name: team
fields.description: The six shown at team preview, pipe-delimited Showdown names in preview order. A Mega shows as its base Pokémon; a form preview hides ("Urshifu-*") takes the form that entered the battle, else its base name

fields.name: brought
fields.description: Every Pokémon of the team that entered the battle, pipe-delimited in order of first appearance; an Illusion that ended is credited to the Pokémon really sent in

fields.name: leads
fields.description: The Pokémon on the field when the battle started, pipe-delimited

fields.name: mega_evolved
fields.description: Team members that Mega Evolved, pipe-delimited (by their preview names)

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: A sample of the replays players chose to upload, not every ladder battle: uploads lean to memorable games
Brought means entered the battle: a Pokémon brought but never sent in can't be told from one left at home, so bring figures read only complete battles (both sides revealed all team_size Pokémon)
Player names are read only to tell which side won and are never stored; the source_url replay page still shows them, so staging stays unpublished and the dashboard shows aggregates only
Official events are played on the game, not Showdown: no replay belongs to an official event and none is joined to RK9 or MunchStats
